parameters.excerpt: bounds the stall duration to an implementation-define short timeout such that the stall is terminated on the timeout if no other conditions have occurred to terminate the stall.
parameters.reasoning: The WRS.STO instruction's short timeout duration is explicitly left as an implementation-defined value. The implementer chooses the bound on stall duration at design time. This is a direct architectural parameter not controlled by any CSR field.

parameters.excerpt: and it does not complete within an implementation-specific bounded time limit, the `WRS.NTO` instruction will cause an illegal-instruction exception.
parameters.reasoning: When the TW bit in mstatus is set (or VTW in hstatus), WRS.NTO must complete within an implementation-specific bounded time limit or trap. This time limit is a direct implementation choice. The same parameter applies to both the TW and VTW cases (lines 51 and 56).
